description.en:
The WABA account ID, PageId, AccountId<props="intl">, or ServiceId</props>.

- If \`ChannelType\` is \`WHATSAPP\`, pass the WABA account ID. View the WABA account ID on the **WABA Management** page by navigating to **Channel Management** > **Manage**.

- If \`ChannelType\` is not \`WHATSAPP\`, pass the PageId for \`MESSENGER\` or the AccountId for \`INSTAGRAM\`<props="intl">. For \`VIBER\`, pass the ServiceId</props>.

title.zh: 流程绑定号码或商家账号ID
title.en: Bind Phone Numbers or Instances to Flow

descriptions.zh:
- 您可调用此接口给流程绑定号码或商家账号ID，也可在[**流程编辑器**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)>**设置**界面手动绑定。

- 在调用此接口之前，请确保您已有创建成功的流程；已有创建成功对应流程类型的消息通道。

- WhatsApp通道类型需已完成[WABA注册及绑定](~~172335~~)、[新增号码](~~2656131~~)。
- Messenger通道类型需已完成[连接公共主页账号](~~2837713~~)。
- Instagram通道类型需已完成[连接专业账户账号](~~2837720~~)。

<props="intl">- Viber通道类型需已完成[申请服务号](~~2807995~~)。</props>
descriptions.en:
- Call this API operation to attach a phone number or a business account ID to a flow. You can also manually attach them on the **Settings** page in the [**Flow Editor**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder).

- Before you call this API operation, make sure that you have created a flow and a message channel of the corresponding type.

- For a WhatsApp channel, you must have completed [WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) registration and binding](~~172335~~) and [added a phone number](~~2656131~~).

- For a Messenger channel, you must have [connected a public homepage account](~~2837713~~).

- For an Instagram channel, you must have [connected a professional account](~~2837720~~).

<props="intl">

- For a Viber channel, you must have [requested a service number](~~2807995~~).

</props>
